headline: Asus confirms eShop data breach, warns of phishing scams
summary: Asus has confirmed a data breach at its eShop that exposed customer contact details and order records, though the company says payment data remains safe. Asus is warning customers about targeted phishing scams as a result, but has not disclosed how many customers were affected.
